issues.title: Level 4 (Twin Bridges): character falls through the floor and falls endlessly after the second bridge, with no death

ticket.title: Level 4 (Twin Bridges): character falls through the floor and falls endlessly after the second bridge, with no death
ticket.summary: Since patch 1.4, players who land on the stone platform after the second bridge on Level 4 (Twin Bridges) fall through the ground and keep falling without dying, so they must quit or restart. Telemetry shows completion dropping from 80% to 43% with restarts rising from 1.2 to 2.6 per player, while deaths per player stayed flat (2.1 to 2.2), and 30 distinct players reported it.

evidence.text: Fell through the map on Twin Bridges three times in a row. Had to quit each time because you don't even die, you just keep falling.
evidence.english: Fell through the map on Twin Bridges three times in a row. Had to quit each time because you don't even die, you just keep falling.

evidence.text: 4 уровень после второго моста падаю сквозь пол, 1.4 broke it
evidence.english: Level 4, after the second bridge I fall through the floor, 1.4 broke it.

evidence.text: Refunding unless this is fixed: falling through the world on level 4 after the second bridge. 100% repro.
evidence.english: Refunding unless this is fixed: falling through the world on level 4 after the second bridge. 100% repro.

evidence.text: Level 4 is broken after the update. You cross the second bridge, land on the platform and drop straight into the void. Lost 40 minutes.
evidence.english: Level 4 is broken after the update. You cross the second bridge, land on the platform and drop straight into the void. Lost 40 minutes.

evidence.text: Twin Bridges-də daş platformaya tullananda yerdən keçirəm, yavaş gedəndə bəzən olmur
evidence.english: In Twin Bridges, when I jump onto the stone platform I fall through the ground; sometimes it doesn't happen when I move slowly.

repro_steps: Start Level 4 (Twin Bridges) on patch 1.4.
Cross the second bridge.
Land on the stone platform/ledge directly after the second bridge (jumping onto it, or walking slowly onto it, may behave differently).
Observe the character clip through the floor and fall endlessly without dying; the level cannot be progressed and the game must be restarted.
ticket.suspected_cause: "Physics and collision optimisation" (patch 1.4). The mechanic is tagged collision, players say the problem started after the 1.4 update (A060, A123), and the failure is a character passing through level geometry, which fits a collision change. This is an inference from the notes and reports, not a confirmed root cause.

repro_steps: Start Level 4 (Twin Bridges) on patch 1.4.
Cross the second bridge.
Land on the stone platform/ledge directly after the second bridge (jumping onto it, or walking slowly onto it, may behave differently).
Observe the character clip through the floor and fall endlessly without dying; the level cannot be progressed and the game must be restarted.
issues.telemetry_evidence: completion 80% → 43%, deaths/player 2.1 → 2.2 (not a difficulty spike), restarts 1.2 → 2.6, error reports 3 → 4

issues.title: Level 6 Magma Warden (boss): 1.4 boss tuning pass made fight HP roughly double and phase 2 too long, causing repeated deaths

ticket.title: Level 6 Magma Warden (boss): 1.4 boss tuning pass made fight HP roughly double and phase 2 too long, causing repeated deaths
ticket.summary: After patch 1.4, players report that the Magma Warden on level 6 has roughly double HP and that phase 2 lasts far longer, e.g. 'phase 2 lasts 4 minutes now' (A105) and 'survives 3 full combos in phase 2, before it was 1' (A167). Telemetry for this boss shows completion falling from 70% to 51%, deaths per player rising from 4.1 to 8.3, and restarts rising from 1.8 to 2.9, across 19 distinct reporting players.

repro_steps: Update the game to patch 1.4.
Start a new run or load a save and reach level 6.
Engage the Magma Warden (boss) and observe its total HP bar length against the pre-1.4 experience described in reports (e.g. A087, A162).
Reach phase 2 and observe how many full combos the boss survives and how long the phase lasts (A105, A167).
Die during the fight and note the number of attempts required (e.g. A075, A162 report 20+ tries).
ticket.suspected_cause: "Boss tuning pass". The 1.4 boss tuning pass is the only patch-note line that changes boss stats, and players attribute the HP increase and longer phase 2 specifically to the level 6 boss rebalance (A037, A087). The notes do not state the exact values changed, so this link is inferred from the timing and the reports.

repro_steps: Update the game to patch 1.4.

ticket.summary: Players report that opening the inventory during the Frost Keep boss fight on level 7 closes the game to desktop, and several say it happens every time (A089, A120). Telemetry matches: error reports rose from 4 to 418, completion fell from 73% to 45%, and restarts rose from 1.3 to 1.9, while deaths per player stayed flat at 3 to 3.1, so this is not a difficulty spike.

Players say it started after the patch (A092: "Since 1.4 the ice boss fight crashes whenever I open my bag. Before the patch it was fine."). The link is inferred from timing and the reported trigger, not confirmed in code.

repro_steps: Start the game on patch 1.4 and progress to level 7, Frost Keep (boss).
Enter the boss fight.

issues.title: Old Mill (Level 2): checkpoint shows 'saved' icon but load returns player to level start after quit/reopen

ticket.title: Old Mill (Level 2): checkpoint shows 'saved' icon but load returns player to level start after quit/reopen
ticket.summary: Players report that the Old Mill checkpoint in level 2 displays the saved icon, but loading after quitting or restarting returns them to the beginning of the level, so progress is lost. Telemetry shows completion dropping from 92% to 90%, restarts rising from 1.1 to 1.8 per player, and error reports rising from 1 to 2, with 12 distinct players reporting and an estimated 229 players lost. Deaths per player are unchanged at 1, so this is not a difficulty spike.

evidence.text: Lost progress twice: the Old Mill checkpoint shows the 'saved' icon but loading puts me at the start of level 2.
evidence.english: Lost progress twice: the Old Mill checkpoint shows the 'saved' icon but loading puts me at the start of level 2.

evidence.english: On Old Mill the save icon shows up, but when I load it returns me to the beginning of the level.

evidence.text: The mill checkpoint only works if you wait a few seconds after the save icon. If you quit right away it's gone.
evidence.english: The mill checkpoint only works if you wait a few seconds after the save icon. If you quit right away it's gone.

evidence.text: 2-ci səviyyədə checkpoint işləmir, oyunu bağlayıb açanda əvvəldən başlayıram.
evidence.english: On level 2 the checkpoint doesn't work; when I close and reopen the game I start from the beginning.

evidence.text: На Old Mill сохранение не работает — значок есть, а после загрузки всё сначала.
evidence.english: On Old Mill saving doesn't work: the icon is there, but after loading everything starts from the beginning.

repro_steps: Start Ember Trail on patch 1.4 and progress to level 2 (Old Mill).
Reach the Old Mill checkpoint and trigger the save; the save icon appears.
Immediately quit the game, or wait a few seconds before quitting (A163 reports quitting right away loses the save).
Reopen the game and load the saved progress.
Observe that the game starts level 2 from the beginning instead of the Old Mill checkpoint.
ticket.suspected_cause: "Save system refactor" - the save system was refactored in patch 1.4, and players report the checkpoint breaking "since the patch" (A027). The checkpoint save appears to be written or reported successfully but is not being persisted or read back correctly, and A163 suggests the write may only complete if the player stays in the game for a few seconds after saving.

repro_steps: Start Ember Trail on patch 1.4 and progress to level 2 (Old Mill).
Reach the Old Mill checkpoint and trigger the save; the save icon appears.
Immediately quit the game, or wait a few seconds before quitting (A163 reports quitting right away loses the save).
Reopen the game and load the saved progress.
Observe that the game starts level 2 from the beginning instead of the Old Mill checkpoint.
issues.telemetry_evidence: completion 92% → 90%, deaths/player 1 → 1 (not a difficulty spike), restarts 1.1 → 1.8, error reports 1 → 2

ticket.summary: Five players report that on level 9 (Archive) in Russian, puzzle hint text overflows its window, overlaps other text, and covers buttons, so clues cannot be read (A031, A033, A107, A122, A144).
